surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: The Wild beat the Golden Knights
paras: The Golden Knights’ Raphaël Lavoie picked up his first NHL point. Rieger Lorenz picked up his first NHL point. Matt Boldy, Maxim Shabanov and Danila Yurov scored three goals in 5:07 midway through the first to put the Wild up 3-0. Rasmus Andersson got the Knights on the board early in the second. William Karlsson pulled the Golden Knights within one midway through the third. Joel Eriksson Ek sealed it into the empty net with 1:22 left.
The Wild had a bit more of the good stuff, outshooting the Golden Knights 28-23. Jesper Wallstedt made 21 saves for the Wild, and Carter Hart stopped 24 of 27.
Lorenz and Jérémy Lauzon dropped the gloves early in the third. The Wild killed all five Golden Knights power plays. The Wild moved to 4-1-1, and the Golden Knights dropped to 5-2-0.
